text: 美国8月贸易逆差大幅扩大至2025年初以来最高水平，资本品进口激增推动进口创下纪录。美国商务部周二公布的数据显示，商品和服务贸易逆差较前月扩大13.7%，至1,056亿美元，预测中值为逆差1,021亿美元。这项月度贸易数据未经通胀调整。自2025年初以来，受美国关税政策以及近期冲突引发的原油价格剧烈波动影响，贸易数据一直容易大幅波动。供应链挑战，以及为满足人工智能领域巨额投资而对进口技术形成的依赖，也在发挥作用。经通胀调整后，8月商品贸易逆差扩大至1,147亿美元，同样为2025年3月以来最大。
text_en: The U.S. trade deficit widened sharply in August to the highest level since early 2025, as a surge in capital goods imports drove imports to a record. Data released by the U.S. Commerce Department on Tuesday showed the goods and services trade deficit widened 13.7% from the previous month to $105.6 billion, versus a median forecast of a $102.1 billion deficit. The monthly trade data is not adjusted for inflation. Since early 2025, trade data has been prone to sharp fluctuations due to U.S. tariff policy and violent swings in crude oil prices triggered by recent conflicts. Supply chain challenges and reliance on imported technology to meet massive investment in artificial intelligence are also playing a role. After inflation adjustment, the August goods trade deficit widened to $114.7 billion, also the largest since March 2025.
